test.create_query: CREATE TABLE volume_reducing_functions (key UInt64, s String, arr Array(UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO volume_reducing_functions SELECT number, randomPrintableASCII(100), range(number % 32) FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT length(s) FROM volume_reducing_functions ORDER BY key FORMAT Null
SELECT lengthUTF8(s) FROM volume_reducing_functions ORDER BY key LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT length(arr) FROM volume_reducing_functions ORDER BY key FORMAT Null
